downside.story: P10: AI demand digests in 2027. Anthropic and OpenAI, a large share of the $578B backlog, slow their commitments, so AWS FY2027 growth falls to ~23% and the margin drops 3 points as the D&A from $300B+ of capex lands on lower utilization. Retail margin stalls (Leo ramp, FTC remedies on ads). The P/E de-rates to ~19x on ~$9.7 NTM EPS, and the Anthropic stake is marked down 40%.

upside.story: P90: capacity converts the backlog faster. AWS grows ~50% in 2027 (above UBS's 43%) at ~40% margins as Trainium lowers cost per token, ads hold ~20% growth, and the market pays ~27x NTM EPS of ~$14. An Anthropic IPO re-marks the stake 40% higher.

downside.story: P10: the cloud market slows toward Big-4 capex growth in 2027 (-10% to the market level) while AWS loses share faster (capture -5%), the depreciation wave takes AWS margin 3pt lower, Walmart takes retail-media share (NA margin -1.2pt), online retail grows ~2% slower, the market de-rates AMZN to ~21x like ORCL/GOOGL on negative FCF, and ANT falls 45% from $89.

Negative FCF (TTM -$42.4B, src 95) and $90B+ of 2026 borrowing become the story; FTC trial (Mar 29, 2027, src 94) adds remedy risk.

downside.story: Driver restatement 2026-10-22: AWS turnover -8% (2027 AWS growth ~24%, the story's low-to-mid 20s), AWS EBITDA margin -2 pts (2027 capex lifting D&A), ads -4%; P/E 17.5x and segment multiples -24% kept; the Anthropic ~$1.0T re-mark rides in eps_pct (the old operating eps_pct -12.2% is now the driver moves) and multiple_pct. AI-capex digestion or a lab customer stumble (forecasters' median bear $195): AWS growth toward the low-to-mid 20s while 2027 capex lifts D&A; ~17.5x on NTM EPS ~$11 as ORCL trades, segment multiples cut by the same 24%, and Anthropic prices at ~$1.0T instead of $1.5T (stakes x 0.67). Sheet layout (no stake scenarios): the stake re-mark (-6.95/share) rides in eps_pct -0.121932 -> -0.153619 (P/E leg) and multiple_pct -0.239130 -> -0.265604 (SOTP leg); every leg value is unchanged.

upside.story: Driver restatement 2026-10-22: AWS turnover +6% (2027 AWS ~43%, the story's 35%+), AWS EBITDA margin +1.5 pts (Trainium), ads +3%; 25.5x and segment multiples +11% kept; the Anthropic ~$1.92T re-mark rides in eps_pct (stake part only) and multiple_pct. AWS holds 35%+ with Trainium, FCF inflects (forecasters' median bull $350 before stakes): ~25.5x on NTM EPS ~$13.75, segment multiples +11%, Anthropic at ~$1.92T (Polymarket first-day-close variant; stakes x 1.28).
